en: Dr. Fe del Mundo invented a makeshift incubator using two native bamboo baskets and a hot water bottle for rural areas.
The original 1898 Philippine Declaration of Independence was written and read aloud in Spanish, not in Tagalog or English.
The Philippine eagle, our national bird, is a rare apex predator that requires a massive forest territory of over 10,000 hectares to survive.
The Philippine Constitution uniquely mandates that at least twenty percent of the national budget must be allocated exclusively for public education.
The indigenous Ifugao people carved the Banaue Rice Terraces over two thousand years ago without any modern machinery or architectural blueprints.
Although the Philippines has over 180 distinct languages, the 1987 Constitution officially recognizes only Filipino and English for formal government use.
Jose Rizal was a polymath who spoke twenty-two languages and published specialized scientific articles detailing the anatomy of the human eye.
Bacolod's MassKara Festival was created in 1980 specifically to lift the city's spirits during a severe economic and local sugar crisis.
The Philippine Bill of Rights strictly prohibits the re-imposition of the death penalty once Congress has previously reduced it by law.
National Artist Carlos Francisco was a pioneer of modern murals who painted massive, historically accurate scenes directly onto public and commercial building walls.
The Filipino value of bayanihan originated from the actual physical practice of neighbors carrying a traditional nipa hut to a new location.
Dr. Ramon Barba invented a simple potassium nitrate flower-inducing technique that transformed the Philippine mango industry into a massive global exporter.
